title: QE reference route to dev08
detail: dft5090 reports pw.x 7.6 (orig-mpi-dfti, MPI, MKL) reachable on dev08, idle, key ssh, scp exchange. Reported not verified; see docs/reference-environment.md. First real run happens in P6.

title: No Si norm-conserving UPF v2 chosen
detail: Si.pz-vbc.UPF exists on dev08 (NC, LDA PZ, z_valence 4, sha256 e8d93375...5217) but author, date and license are blank. Provenance unverified; needs a user decision before use.

title: FFT backend decided
detail: ADR 0004: ndrustfft over rustfft. NEON effect still unmeasured.

title: codex mcp-server removed from Codex CLI
detail: Using codex exec through scripts/delegate.sh (approved by the user). Verified by the smoke test and the P0 run.

title: Codex sandbox blocks network
detail: No external crates in P0. Crates must be vetted and fetched by Claude.

title: delegate.sh fork mode untested
detail: new mode verified by smoke test; fork and resume still unverified.

title: Engine LICENSE not decided
detail: Left to the user; no GPL code is copied.

title: Complex linear algebra backend decided
detail: ADR 0004: faer for complex Hermitian eig and GEMM, LAPACK kept as test oracle. Evidence in docs/backend-spike-results.md.

title: Codex sandbox cannot commit in a worktree
detail: Git metadata lives outside the worktree folder. Claude commits after verification.

title: Existing hand-written Accelerate FFI conflicts with library policy
detail: Hand-written real ddot/dsyev FFI in dft-numerics is deleted in P1 (ADR 0004).

title: Debug-mode spike test took 707 s
detail: Spike code not merged (tag spike/p0c). Rule added: tests over about 10 s in debug must be #[ignore] with a release command.
